sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Zumba Mania is a match-three puzzle game where you clear a grid of marbles by matching three or more of the same-colored ones. Sounds simple, right? But here's the twist - you have a limited amount of time to clear the board before a chain of marbles reaches the end. As the game progresses, the speed of the marbles increases, and you'll need to think quickly to keep up. But don't worry, you'll have power-ups at your disposal to give you an edge.

The game's grid consists of a series of marbles, each with a different color. Your goal is to clear the entire grid by matching three or more marbles of the same color. You can do this by clicking on a marble to swap it with a neighboring marble. If you create a match of three or more marbles, they will be cleared from the grid, and you'll earn points for each match. The faster you clear the grid, the more points you'll earn.

As you progress through each level, the game will introduce new obstacles and challenges to keep things interesting. You may encounter marbles that are locked behind a series of other marbles, or ones that are stuck to the grid and require a specific combination to clear. But don't worry - these challenges are designed to make the game more engaging and fun, rather than frustrating. With practice and patience, you'll master the game's core mechanics and be ready to take on more challenging levels.
